title: AWS Data Engineer
description:
Location: London (Hybrid) with occasional client travel

Salary: Up to £60,000


We're recruiting for a Data Engineer to join a growing consultancy, delivering production-grade data platforms for some of the UK's leading organisations.

This is a client-facing role where you'll design and build scalable cloud-based data solutions, working with modern technologies including AWS, Databricks and Agentic AI. You'll benefit from structured training, clear career progression and the opportunity to work on complex, enterprise-scale projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain scalable ETL/ELT data pipelines and cloud-based data platforms.
  • Develop robust data architectures and support the full software development lifecycle.
  • Build tooling for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration and data quality.
  • Work directly with clients to understand requirements and deliver high-quality data solutions.
  • Explore and apply emerging technologies, including Agentic AI, to improve data engineering processes.

About You You'll have:

  • 2–4 years' experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong skills in Python, SQL and DBT.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Databricks.
  • Knowledge of AWS services including S3, Lambda, Glue, RDS and DynamoDB.
  • Experience with Terraform or AWS CDK, Git and modern development practices.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A passion for emerging technologies, particularly Agentic AI, and a customer-focused approach.
